top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Mojsov; GLP-1 physiology and active peptide forms) is a mature, original discovery arc confirmed over decades and in large randomized trials in type 2 diabetes and obesity. The citation is limited to physiology and active forms, so it does not claim the drugs. The weaknesses are the exclusion of Knudsen and the contested Mojsov versus Habener priority on the active form. Neither is serious enough to prefer no award, which would withhold a clearly deserving achievement.
recusal_note: No documented tie to Drucker, Holst, Mojsov or Knudsen. Profile records about twenty co-authored works with committee member Thomas Perlmann and a postdoctoral period with Paul Greengard, neither involving this candidate; no recusal apparent from profile.
